stem: ![](asset:P000245-stem-1) Two surfaces A and B are placed as shown in the figure. A particle is projected perpendicularly from the surface A with a velocity ‘u’ such that it hits the surface B perpendicularly. Find the time taken by the projectile in terms of u and g?

assets.alt: Two planes meeting at O on the ground: plane A inclined at 30° and plane B at 60° on the other side. A particle is launched from a point on A with speed u perpendicular to A.

Two lines from O: OA at 30° and OB at 60° to the ground. A projectile starts on OA with u perpendicular to OA and strikes OB with v perpendicular to OB; u is parallel to OB and the final v parallel to AO.
